headline: Continued public hearing on Haffner's Way Definitive Subdivision Plan for properties on Sargent Street, Millett Street, Gale Road, and Gloucester Avenue.
summary: A continued public hearing on an application from Energy North Incorporated for approval of the Haffner's Way Definitive Subdivision Plan. The plan covers properties at 40 Sargent Street, 46 Millett Street, 10 Gale Road, 18 Gale Road, and 131R Gloucester Avenue.

## Continued Public Hearing

In accordance with the provisions of Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 41, § 81T, the Planning Board to consider an application submitted by Energy North Incorporated for approval of a Definitive Subdivision Plan entitled "Haffner's Way Definitive Subdivision Plan." located at **40 Sargent Street, 46 Millett Street, 10 Gale Road, 18 Gale Road, and 131R Gloucester Avenue** (Assessor's Map 32, Lots 18 and 22; Map 33, Lot 3; and Map 43, Lots 1 and 2).

REQUESTED TO BE CONTINUED TO NOVEMBER 19, 2026
